# Deflection quality quadrant

`customer_support.df.self_service_deflection.deflection_quality_quadrant` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Cross found-versus-not-found with solved-versus-not-solved. Only one cell is a success, and the found-but-not-solved cell is the one that produces angry repeat contacts.

Blended deflection collapses all four cells into one number and hides the only cell that tells you something actionable. Found-but-not-solved is a content defect; not-found is a findability or coverage defect; the fixes are opposite and the volume is identical.

## How to apply

- Cross found-versus-not-found with solved-versus-not-solved. Only one cell is a success, and the found-but-not-solved cell is the one that produces angry repeat contacts.
- Blended deflection collapses all four cells into one number and hides the only cell that tells you something actionable. Found-but-not-solved is a content defect; not-found is a findability or coverage defect; the fixes are opposite and the volume is identical.
